contexts.text: To be prepared and full of goods. Signified.
Hence the formula, To sweep and prepare the way. Illustrated.
To prepare and prepare one's self to receive truth. Signified.
They shall be prepared for the third day () = plenary preparation.
To be prepared () = to be in the endeavour.
To prepare the way () = to prepare for introduction.
His Wife hath made herself ready () = that those who will be of this Church... are being collected, inaugurated, and instructed.
Prepared as a Bride adorned for her Husband () = that Church conjoined with the Lord through the Word.
Prepared means girt for betrothal, and the Church is thus girt... through the Word. Explained.
For everyone must prepare the way for God; that is, must prepare himself for reception; and this is done through Knowledges.
Divine order is, that man... prepares himself to be a receptacle and habitation into which God may enter...
To prepare one's self for the reception of God... is to live according to Divine order.
To be prepared for an hour... = to be continually in the state.
To make herself ready = to be adorned with truths from good for the reception.
